short_description: Consumer-facing lifestyle trait that reports a cautious panel-relative signal for walk-duration tendency within the current local reference panel.
summary_note: Usable consumer-facing movement trait describing a cautious inherited signal related to longer or shorter usual walking duration relative to the current local reference panel.
what_it_measures: A panel-relative polygenic signal associated with a tendency toward longer or shorter walk duration, calibrated within the current local empirical reference panel.
interpretation_template: This is a cautious panel-relative movement signal, not a direct readout of how long you currently walk in everyday life. {interpretation}
caution_text: Use as a cautious panel-relative signal only. No imputation or ancestry-adjusted normalization is used, and the output should not be treated as a direct readout of current walking habits, endurance, or health status.
limitations: Percentiles and z-scores are relative to the local reference panel, not to a population-wide benchmark.
Real-world walking duration depends strongly on age, work routine, transport access, fitness, pain, injury, environment, and personal choice.
This trait should not be used as an endurance test or medical interpretation.
confidence_note: Confidence reflects overlap and reference robustness under the no-imputation raw-array workflow, not certainty about the real-world trait.
reference_note: Percentiles and z-scores are calibrated against a local empirical reference artifact built from raw-array files in this project; they are panel-relative, not population-wide.
